title: [YCQL] Fatal when using order by for non-existent column with index scan.
body:
### Example:

#### Set up a table with an index.
```
create keyspace sample;
use sample;
create table test(a int primary key, b int, c int) with transactions = {'enabled' : true};
create index on test(b);
```
#### Sequential (primary key) select works as expected
```
select * from test where a = 3 order by non_existent_column;
```
```
InvalidRequest: Error from server: code=2200 [Invalid query] message="Undefined Column. Column doesn't exist
select * from test where a = 3 order by non_existent_column;
                                        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 (ql error -203)"
```
#### Index scan crashes (instead of return error)
```
select * from test where b = 3 order by non_existent_column;
```
```
NoHostAvailable:
```
